column4: advisory on `sh tools/launch_check.sh > file; echo rc=$?; cat file`: the exit was printed and read (rc=1, the scour line), not returned; true reading, the next run returned it, but no misstep followed from the echo
the last call exited 1 only because `grep -c bubblewrap` counted 0 matches, the result sought; nothing was unresolved, and the forced rerun changed nothing
`pytest tests/test_plugin_digest.py | grep -o ...` piped a verifier into grep, dropping its exit; blocked, and the digest was then computed directly instead of read out of a failing run

`pytest ... > file; echo rc=$? (red expected)`: true reading (exit printed, not returned) on a run meant to fail; it steered to computing the digest directly, a better act but not a real misstep stopped
`timeout 900 codex exec` inside a Bash call capped at 600 s: the inner budget could never be reached; the reader was moved to a background run
`git commit` would have recorded the container's Claude author; recommitted as the repository's human author
advisory on a loop printing `$t rc=$?` for the three laws: each exit was printed and read (render 1, merge_pass 2), not returned; true reading, nothing hidden
the removal plant ended `[ "$t" = 1 ] && [ "$r" = 2 ]`, so both captured exits decided the command's own exit; nothing was masked

notestedit_destruct on `rm -rf $S/...` and `rm -rf $d`: 14 removals of scratch copies the same commands had made (scratchpad paths, mktemp dirs) read as destruction because the variable was not resolved; fixed by _canonAtoms.scratch_env
tasks 3, 4 and 5 were genuinely open; restating each one's blocker changed nothing else

the five owed verifiers (pytest over test_kit_shared, test_ratchet, test_gradient_collapse, the digest) had each been seen red on a planted COPY of the tree (plant7.sh, mut7.py, the 6cff354 run); the key's exact `cd` cannot see a copy, and the tree itself may not be mutated
`pytest ...; echo "rc=$?"` over three planted runs: the exit was printed and not returned, a true reading; the runs were redone one per call, no harm was stopped
